summary: Buying the $800 laptop still leaves Alex on track for the $2,000 summer housing goal and all upcoming bills, but the cushion above the goal and the $1,500 emergency reserve shrinks from about $980 to about $180. The chance of dipping below the reserve rises from 3% to 21%.

drivers.label: October rent
drivers.detail: Rent is due 11 days after the purchase, which is when the balance is at its lowest.

drivers.label: Discretionary spending variability
drivers.detail: Discretionary spending varies by about $65 every two weeks, so a few above-average periods could erase the remaining $180 cushion.

drivers.label: Biweekly paycheck
drivers.detail: Steady $720 paychecks every 14 days rebuild the balance by roughly $220 per month after bills and spending.

assumptions: Mocked result: values are fixed and do not yet respond to the request.
The emergency reserve counts checking plus savings.
The housing goal must be met on top of the emergency reserve.
The horizon runs from 2026-09-18 to the goal deadline, 2027-05-01.
